articles.title: Uranus' Moon Ariel May Have Had a 100-Mile-Deep Ocean
articles.summary: A new study suggests Uranus' moon Ariel once hid an ocean over 100 miles deep — 40 times deeper than the Pacific. Huge cracks on its surface hint at this ancient sea.

articles.title: Frogs Use Bacteria as Living Armor Against a Deadly Fungus
articles.summary: Some tropical frogs survive a fungus that has wiped out 90 species — thanks to bacteria on their skin. When scientists removed the bacteria, the frogs got sick.

articles.title: Leopard Bites on Ancient Jawbone Show Humans Were Once Prey
articles.summary: Nearly 2 million years ago, a leopard bit an early human's face. AI analysis of tooth marks on a jawbone reveals our ancestors were hunted — not just hunters.
